
[[File:Blueprints.png|thumb|300px|left|A blueprint]]

= Blueprints =
'''Blueprints''' are special unlockable items in ''Prospecting!''.  
They are required for certain high-tier [[Equipment]] to appear in the crafting menu at the [[Blacksmith]].  

== How Blueprints Work ==
* Once obtained, a blueprint permanently unlocks the ability to craft its associated equipment.  
* Blueprints are consumed upon use and cannot be traded or sold.  
* Equipment that requires a blueprint will '''not show up in the crafting menu''' until the blueprint has been used.  

== How to Obtain Blueprints ==
Most blueprints can be obtained through [[Quests|quests]], though some can be purchased, and at least one can be found just lying around on the ground.
